segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to pursue a business combination with a target not yet selected; it has no operations.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has determined that there is only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company has no customers; its income is interest earned on the IPO proceeds held in the Trust Account, not operating revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: We will generate non-operating income in the form of interest income from the proceeds derived from our IPO and held in the Trust Account.
